Parent Orientation | Vidyashilp School, Sarjapur
A meaningful beginning starts with a conversation. 🌱

On 26 September, Vidyashilp School, Sarjapur, hosted a Parent Orientation that brought prospective parents closer to our educational philosophy, learning environment, and the experiences we envision for every child.

It was an opportunity to understand what we believe, how we learn, and how we nurture curious, confident, and compassionate learners.

📍 Vidyashilp School, Sarjapur

✨ AN AUSPICIOUS BEGINNING ✨

A new chapter in the Vidyashilp journey begins! 🌱
As the new Vidyashilp School campus in Sarjapur takes shape, we gathered to seek blessings for an auspicious beginning and a future filled with learning, growth, and meaningful possibilities.
The Puja Ceremony marked this special milestone, bringing our community together as we look forward to creating a vibrant space where young minds can learn, discover, and flourish. 🙏✨
Here’s to new beginnings and an exciting journey ahead! 💙
